name: Egor Demin
detail: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

name: Kon Knueppel
detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday. He remains out for Friday's contest against the Wizards.

name: Dailyn Swain
detail: Swain (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston.

name: Jaylon Tyson
detail: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

name: Meleek Thomas
detail: Thomas (foot) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

name: Sergio de Larrea
detail: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

name: Santi Aldama
detail: Aldama (knee) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

name: Tarik Biberovic
detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

name: Alpha Diallo
detail: Diallo (personal/wrist) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Phoenix, Vic Lombardi of Altitude Sports reports.

name: Isaiah Joe
detail: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Nets.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
detail: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

name: Reed Sheppard
detail: Houston picked up Sheppard's (back) fourth-year team option Friday, per Lachard Binkley of SI.com.

name: Alperen Sengun
detail: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Mavericks, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Obi Toppin
detail: Toppin (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Miami.

name: T.J. McConnell
detail: McConnell (hamstring) is practicing in the G League at Noblesville Boom training camp, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Johnny Furphy
detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Ivica Zubac
detail: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

name: Ben Sheppard
detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
detail: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
detail: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Max Strus
detail: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
detail: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Ziaire Williams
detail: Williams has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left foot injury management, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

name: Adou Thiero
detail: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
detail: Pippen (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.

name: Ty Jerome
detail: Jerome (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.

name: Quinten Post
detail: Post (ankle) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Kings.

name: Anthony Edwards
detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

name: Yves Missi
detail: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

name: Jordan Poole
detail: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

name: Jose Alvarado
detail: Alvarado (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Philadelphia.

name: Cason Wallace
detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Chet Holmgren
detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Jalen Williams
detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

name: Alex Caruso
detail: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Jonathan Isaac
detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game in Toronto.

name: Jaylen Brown
detail: Brown (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Knicks.

name: Jabari Walker
detail: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game versus New York.

name: Robert Williams III
detail: Williams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Jazz.

name: Chris Youngblood
detail: Youngblood (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game against Utah.

name: Ja Morant
detail: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

name: Tobias Harris
detail: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

name: Kawhi Leonard
detail: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

name: Lauri Markkanen
detail: Markkanen (wrist) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Portland.

name: Justin Champagnie
detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
